name: Annette Taddeo
summary:
Annette Joanne Taddeo-Goldstein (née Taddeo ; born April 7, 1967) is an American politician and businesswoman who served as a member of the Florida Senate from the 40th district from 2017 to 2022. She is a member of the Democratic Party.
She ran unsuccessfully in several elections starting in 2008.
